entry.key: With accounts, everyone who opens this database logs in with a name and a password, can do only what the level of the account allows, and every operation is recorded with the account. Two accounts are made now: a Master account, which only manages the accounts, and a Full access account for the work. Accounts are never deleted (an account can be locked). Keep the Master password safe: nobody can recover it.

Ora vengono creati due account: un account Master, che gestisce solo gli account, e un account ad Accesso completo per il lavoro. Gli account non vengono mai eliminati (un account si può bloccare). Conserva con cura la password Master: nessuno può recuperarla.
